data.content:
Mansfield will be without Grenada international Lucas Akins and defender Billy Cargill for this clash as both continue their recovery from hamstring injuries. Veteran striker David McGoldrick also recently picked up a knock and has missed the previous two games, making him a doubt to feature as well. [...] ## 

## TEAM NEWS

Jamie McDonnell is likely to remain sidelined for the next few weeks with the hamstring injury suffered during the game against Cambridge last month, while the likes of Ruben Roosken, Aidomo Emakhu and Jin Woo Jeon are nearing a return to fitness and hope to be available in the coming weeks.

Otherwise, there are no additional injury concerns following the weekend's victory at Notts County. [...] Image

sparky

After spending a successful campaign with the Stags last season on loan at Mansfield Town, midfielder Jonathan Russell has picked up where he left off after signing permanently in the summer. The 26-year-old scored five goals in the second half of the 2025/26 season for Mansfield whilst on loan from Barnsley, and has scored two goals in four games this season as a permanent member of the Town squad.

# Mansfield Town vs Oxford United preview: Injury news, how to watch on TV, H2H record, League One form

By Georgia Goulding

Published 14th Oct 2026, 20:00 BST

## Mansfield Town and Oxford United will face off in League One on Thursday evening. [...] Mansfield Town midfielder Nathan Moriah-Welsh (22) celebrates his 1st half goal during the Sky Bet League 1 match against Luton Town FC at the One Call Stadium, 30 Aug 2026, Photo credit Chris & Jeanette Holloway / The Bigger Picture.media

What time is kick-off?

Stags vs Oxford United will get underway at the One Call Stadium on Thursday, 15 October at 8pm BST.

Match day news [...] Stags will host the U’s, who were relegated from the Championship last season, in their fifth home match of the 2026/27 season.

Mansfield are unbeaten at the One Call Stadium this campaign and have not lost a home match since February. Oxford have won three of their four away games since their drop to League One.

Here’s everything you need to know ahead of the Thursday’s fixture, including how to watch the match live on TV.
